name: MongoDB 8
author: noahfaiq@gmail.com
description: MongoDB 8 (currently the 8.3 line, supported until Oct 2029) with authentication enforced. Runs mongod in the foreground for clean shutdowns; connect with mongosh/Compass using the admin credentials. Changing the admin username or password requires a Reinstall to apply (data is kept). Requires a CPU with AVX (x86_64) or ARMv8.2-A (arm64).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# MongoDB 8 installation script
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
# Safe to re-run: existing data is kept, the admin user is created or its
# password is reset to the current panel value.
set -euo pipefail

SERVER_DIR=/mnt/server
DATA_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/mongodb"
mkdir -p "${DATA_DIR}"
cd "${SERVER_DIR}"

# Always write a known-good config; keep a backup of any previous one.
if [ -f mongod.conf ]; then
    BACKUP="mongod.conf.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
    cp mongod.conf "${BACKUP}"
    echo "Existing mongod.conf backed up to ${BACKUP}"
fi

cat > mongod.conf <<'EOF'
# MongoDB 8 configuration - generated by the installer.
# Port, bind address and --auth are also enforced on the startup command line.
storage:
  dbPath: /home/container/mongodb
net:
  bindIpAll: true
  unixDomainSocket:
    enabled: false
security:
  authorization: enabled
setParameter:
  enableLocalhostAuthBypass: false
EOF

# Start a temporary, local-only instance without auth to manage the admin user.
mongod --dbpath "${DATA_DIR}" --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port 27017 --nounixsocket \
       --fork --logpath /tmp/mongod-install.log \
    || { echo "mongod failed to start:"; tail -n 50 /tmp/mongod-install.log; exit 1; }
trap 'mongod --dbpath "${DATA_DIR}" --shutdown >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT

# Credentials are read from the environment, never interpolated into code.
mongosh --quiet --port 27017 admin --eval '
const user = process.env.MONGO_USER;
const pwd = process.env.MONGO_USER_PASS;
if (db.getUser(user)) {
    db.updateUser(user, { pwd: pwd, roles: ["root"] });
    print("Reset password for existing admin user: " + user);
} else {
    db.createUser({ user: user, pwd: pwd, roles: ["root"] });
    print("Created admin user: " + user);
}'

mongod --dbpath "${DATA_DIR}" --shutdown
trap - EXIT

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "MongoDB installation completed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Mongo Admin Username
variables.description: Username of the MongoDB root user (authenticates against the 'admin' database). Reinstall to apply changes.

variables.name: Mongo Admin Password
variables.description: Password of the MongoDB root user, at least 16 characters. Reinstall to apply changes (data is kept).

variables.name: WiredTiger Cache Size (GB)
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty to let MongoDB size its cache from the container memory limit (50% of RAM minus 1 GB, minimum 0.25 GB). Set lower if the server is being OOM-killed.
